text: It has 1,000 games and doesn't require an internet connection, so your child doesn't have to be online. Because honestly, the internet nowadays isn't very reliable. It also plays music and videos. You can even load movies onto it and take it with you anyway. Actually, I bought it as a gift for my nephew, and he loved it. This might be the best gift you can give your child right now. I'll leave it for you at the orange shopping cart.
